SHARED_OPERATOR_SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.D: for each ROI under B, >=6/8 participants G_shared>0
SHARED_OPERATOR_SUPPORTED_requires_ALL.E: G_beyond_gain positive median in >=2/3 ROIs AND Holm-rejects in >=1/3

SHARED_OPERATOR_INCONCLUSIVE: common space fails / too few evaluable / leakage / numerical failure
